visual_logic: Isolates a singular, hyper-specialized front tooth to showcase the unique fish-spearing adaptation of this theropod.
prompt: High-fidelity 3D asset of a single fossilized front tooth from a Masiakasaurus, rendered in a 3D animated feature film aesthetic with clean, slightly stylized contours. The specimen showcases a highly unique, heavily curved, elongated spear-like incisor morphology. The tooth tip hooks forward subtly, featuring fine, realistic enamel texture lines, minor wear scratches, and a solid, non-fragmented root base. The asset is positioned vertically and centered perfectly within a 1:1 square canvas, meticulously scaled to maintain a strict 25% negative space framing buffer on all four sides to prevent UI clipping. Set against a seamless, solid light-grey studio floor plane with soft, realistic ambient occlusion and a subtle contact shadow cast directly underneath to establish physical weight. A clean, integrated checkered black-and-white scientific scale bar is positioned centered at the bottom.
